selected_evidence.requirement: node1<->node2 traffic is mirrored to node3 despite being addressed elsewhere
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline (cmd-eadb...) shows 0 packets captured on node3 for node1<->node2 traffic; after nftables dup rules were installed (cmd-c561...), node3's capture (cmd-f9ff...) shows both ICMP echo request and reply between 10.100.189.10 and 10.100.189.11, still addressed to each other, appearing on node3's interface.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1<->node2 traffic keeps flowing as before (unaffected by mirroring)
selected_evidence.summary: Ping from node1 to node2 shows 0% packet loss and normal RTT both immediately after enabling TEE rules and after switching to the working nftables dup rules.

selected_evidence.requirement: mirroring configuration persists across node1 reboot
selected_evidence.summary: nftables.service was enabled and /etc/nftables.conf syntax-validated with the mirror table appended (cmd-9091...); after node1's restart, `nft list table ip mirror` (cmd-57dc...) shows the identical rules still active with nftables.service active.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 8e8823ec captured (cmd-3163...); reboot acknowledged and returned (cmd-f109...); connection reset confirms disconnect (cmd-38df...); post-restart poll shows new boot_id ecc7ffb8 with uptime 37s (cmd-9c16...); post-restart mirroring capture on node3 (cmd-f7a0...) and node1<->node2 ping at 0% loss (cmd-8739...) prove recovery.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 3fad4432 and systemd running state captured (cmd-1331...); reboot scheduled (cmd-5c41...); post-restart poll shows new boot_id e8aaa441 with uptime 31s (cmd-9bc8...); post-restart node1<->node2 ping 0% loss (cmd-ed25...) and node3 mirror capture showing ICMP both ways (cmd-9399...) prove full recovery.

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id f9bf293d captured (cmd-9a13...); reboot scheduled (cmd-c100...); post-restart poll shows new boot_id aa54844f with uptime 30s (cmd-9b81...); post-restart interface/systemd health confirmed and new capture started (cmd-3343...); node1<->node2 ping 0% loss (cmd-4ba5...) and final mirrored ICMP capture on node3 (cmd-0cbb...) prove full recovery of the mirroring capability after all three restarts.
